Both of these compounds are predicted to interact with the same downstream target, Serine/threonine-protein kinase ATR. The cumulative scores from the two paths indicate a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, with Gomisin C being a central node in the network of targets leading to ATR. The shared pathway suggests that Gomisin C may act through a common mechanism or pathway to influence ATR activity, potentially through the modulation of Endothelial lipase. The evidence supports a plausible biological link, but further experimental validation would be necessary to confirm the direct interaction and functional role of Gomisin C in regulating ATR.
